allCommands: SELECT id, name, description, category, perms, enabled FROM collectCommands ORDER BY name ASC
allMonsters: SELECT id, gameName, customName FROM collectMonsterNames ORDER BY id ASC
allObjectives: SELECT id, requirement, active FROM collectObjectives ORDER BY id ASC
allQuotes: SELECT id, text, speaker, game, date, favorite FROM collectQuotes ORDER BY id ASC
allChapters: SELECT id AS chapterId, chapterNumber, title AS chapterTitle, body AS chapterText FROM legendsChapters ORDER BY chapterNumber ASC
allChapterAudio: SELECT chapterId, id, url, label, sortOrder FROM legendsAudio ORDER BY chapterId ASC, sortOrder ASC, id ASC
allChapterStreams: SELECT chapterId, id, url, date, sortOrder FROM legendsStreams ORDER BY chapterId ASC, sortOrder ASC, id ASC
randomQuote: SELECT text FROM collectQuotes ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
randomMonster: SELECT gameName, customName FROM collectMonsterNames ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
randomObjective: SELECT requirement FROM collectObjectives WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
quoteById: SELECT text FROM collectQuotes WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1
monsterById: SELECT gameName, customName FROM collectMonsterNames WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1
objectiveById: SELECT requirement FROM collectObjectives WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1
searchQuoteByText: SELECT text FROM collectQuotes WHERE text LIKE ? LIMIT 1
searchMonsterByName: SELECT gameName, customName FROM collectMonsterNames WHERE gameName LIKE ? LIMIT 1
searchObjectiveByRequirement: SELECT requirement FROM collectObjectives WHERE requirement LIKE ? LIMIT 1
